operators.name: custom_reduce_sum
semantics: The input tensor is float32 on CUDA.
Output is a float32 tensor of shape [512,3] (for input [512,3,768,768] and dims (2,3)).
Reduction follows PyTorch semantics, including accumulation order (but atol/rtol tolerance applied).

operators.name: custom_round
semantics: Computes torch.round(x) on the input tensor.
Input is float32 CUDA tensor, output same shape and dtype.
Rounding uses round-half-to-even (PyTorch semantics) to match torch.round.
Reduces input tensor x over dimensions (2,3) using torch.sum.
Output shape becomes [512,3], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Value equals reference torch.sum output (within tolerance).
Applies torch.round to the reduced tensor.
Output shape [512,3], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Value equals reference torch.round output (within tolerance).
